usedFor: Webinargeek knows who registered and watched, and Google Docs receives those details as text in a chosen tab.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Webinargeek, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each sign-up can be written into a Doc tab, so your team can edit the attendee list.

watchOut: “New Registration” polls on a schedule, so a sign-up reaches the document a little later.
